question_text: If 35% of a number is 840, what is the number?

hint_ladder.title: Gawing equation ang problema
hint_ladder.text: Hayaan N ang kabuuan. Mula sa '35% ng N ay 840', isulat: 0.35 × N = 840. Parang pagbibilang ng paninda sa palengke.

hint_ladder.title: I-verify ang sagot
hint_ladder.text: 35% ng 2,400 = 0.35 × 2,400 = 840. Tugma! Kaya kumpiyansa kang 2,400 ang tamang sagot.

A.text: You might have chosen A because after getting N = 840/0.35 = 2,400, you erroneously deducted 200 thinking of a discount.

B.text: You might have chosen B because after dividing 840 by 0.35 you miscalculated 840/35 as 23 instead of 24, giving 2,300.

C.text: Correct. By solving 0.35N = 840, we get N = 840 / 0.35 = 2,400.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you misread the percentage and computed 35% of 2,500 = 875, overlooking that 875 ≠ 840.

next_time_rule: To find the whole from a part: whole = part ÷ (% as decimal). Example: 840 ÷ 0.35 = 2,400. Remember: huwag mag-multiply!
blueprint_id: Finding the Whole from a Part
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo, Ate/Kuya, nag-ipon ka ng pera mula sa iyong sari-sari store. Sinabi ni Tindera Aling Nena na ang 35% ng total na kita niyo ngayong linggo ay 840 pesos. Para malaman ang kabuuang kita, gamitin ang equation: part = % × whole. Dito, 840 = 0.35 × N.

Ngayon, para i-solve ang N, hatiin ang 840 sa 0.35. Tandaan: 0.35 = 35/100. So, 840 ÷ 0.35 = 840 × (100/35). 840/35 = 24, then 24 × 100 = 2,400. Kaya ang kabuuang kita ay 2,400 pesos. Panalo!
